Start date: 1762-08-11  
Add 8 weeks = 56 days.  
Add 4 days → total 60 days.  
1762 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100 and not by 400).  
August has 31 days → from Aug 11, add 20 days to reach Aug 31 (20 days used).  
Remaining 40 days: September (30 days) → 10 days left into October.  
New date: 1762-10-10.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1762-10-10
